rounds: Two weeks of the same outfit to work, same routine, going through the motions — the Joy Police kept things very beige and very safe. Then a colleague literally handed you an opening — they asked about the Apollo ring — and instead of even a half-answer, you closed the door. The ring was right there on your finger doing its job and the Joy Police snatched the moment anyway.
pattern: They're not loud anymore — they're just quietly replacing every opening with a shrug.
focus: One stranger gets one true sentence about the ring
